title: Grade the eye-height frame, not the wide establishing shot
note: The eye-height frame at spawn sits in a grounded, contrasty band — measured where the player looks, not on a wide default camera.
intent: A mid-key band satisfied on a wide default camera while every eye-height frame was washed out: the wide shot averages sky and ground, the player's view does not. Grade against eye:spawn — mean luma low, well under half the pixels lit, and a real black floor with at least a tenth of the frame near black. Get there with lighting rather than exposure: fewer, brighter, more directional sources; unlit surfaces genuinely dark; ambient low. Then check the wide camera, not the other way round.

check.note: Eye-height frame at spawn sits in a grounded, contrasty band: mean luma 0.18-0.30, at most 60% of pixels lit, at least 12% near black — measured where the player looks, not on a wide default camera (which the mid-key grade-band satisfied while the eye frames were washed).

port: The lighting facet names eye:spawn as its primary camera and puts its pixel checks there.
